title: Bounded prose-inference cue probe
scope: A review-only probe; validator semantics are unchanged.

method.input: Eight hand-labelled observation strings covering causal prose, direct observations, reported assertions, and review observations.
method.detector: Flag an observation when it contains one of: because, therefore, thus, so, means, prove(s), establish(es), confirm(s), demonstrate(s).
method.interpretation: Cue matches are review signals, not truth or inference verdicts.

finding.result: A small transparent cue set catches explicit because/demonstrates phrasing but misses given-that and it-follows phrasing.
finding.implication: A lexical qualifier could be useful as a review-only warning, but this sample does not justify enforcement or a validator semantic change.
finding.next_test: Expand with paraphrase and quoted-source controls, then measure whether a typed review warning changes a decision without blocking benign records.
